title: Engineer - Product Management
description:
Role & responsibilities Conduct market research, field surveys & customer visits Collect and analyze Voice of Customer (VOC) and market feedback Support product trials, demonstrations & field evaluations Benchmark competitors and identify product improvement opportunities Convert customer insights into product improvements & new product development Coordinate with R&D, Production, Quality, Sales & Marketing teams Monitor field performance and recommend product enhancements Support NPI, product launches, positioning & dealer/customer training Prepare product, market intelligence & competitor analysis reports Travel across India for field trials, market studies & customer interactions

title: Customer Support Executive
description:
CSE profile starts with handling client query related to generalize accounting software. Require to provide telephonic or online support for software installation, training on the software and other routine queries including accounting queries. Provide client support while trouble shooting like printer setup query etc. Handle complaints or objections if any and report or escalate the same to the next level for further solution. Handle frequent reviews and follow-ups with clients as per need. Collaborate with team members to achieve better results.

Key Skills: Customer Support,Software Support,Client Coordination,Customer Support Executive,Support Executive,Client Support Executive.,ERP Support,Client Satisfaction
